submittedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One full desktop DooKnow recent-notes INITIAL LOADING page, about 1440x1000. Image 1 gives real content/geometry, Image 2 gives header and compact flat style. Preserve the real DooKnow book identity and full horizontal global header as in Image 2. A narrow left owner rail has account O, 笔记/最近/收藏/应用, bottom 回收站/设置. Keep the contextual sidebar and its search field, 新建 split button, contextual heading, add-folder and refresh icons, and resize divider. No invented navigation or header actions. Select 最近 in rail.
Context sidebar heading 最近编辑, then only the exact empty-feed message 暂无最近编辑的笔记. There are ZERO sidebar notes and no 查看全部 button. Main heading hierarchy 我的笔记 then 最近; 0 篇笔记 and 按最近修改排序. Main refresh icon is disabled, 新建笔记 stays enabled. Below show exactly six simple skeleton cards in a three-column two-row grid. Both main and sidebar represent the SAME empty initial-loading feed, never 0 versus 3. No loaded note cards, pagination, empty-main CTA, or error banner. Flat white #ffffff main/header, #f7f8fa context sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #e6e9f1 thin borders, #4566c6 blue and #edf1ff selection. Crisp Chinese sans-serif, 8px corners, no texture/gradient. Keep global horizontal header with DooKnow book identity visible. No browser chrome or invented navigation. Source/role/initial-loading caption belongs to metadata.
